lines.text: Is it has or there is?
Many learners say: It has a lot of people here.
Better: There are a lot of people here.
There are! There are many people here.

data.wrong: It has a lot of people here.
data.right: There are a lot of people here.

native.tip: Para dizer que existe algo, use “there is” ou “there are”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “It has a lot of people here.”. O certo é “There are a lot of people here.”. O verbo “ter” do português tem dois usos; em inglês são dois verbos. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “There are”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: To say that something exists, use “there is” or “there are”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “It has a lot of people here.”. The right way is “There are a lot of people here.”. The Portuguese “ter” has two uses; English uses two different verbs. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
